title: Final: formats, share copies and the report
judge_notes: The attached videos are the 9:16 masters of Version A (when it was made) and Version B; out/report.md is pasted below them. Nothing is published by the skill; the report tells the user what to do at upload.

questions.text: Does each made version have 9:16, 1:1 and 16:9 files and a share copy under 25 MB?
Does out/report.md have the sections Scores, Flaws, Claims, Spend and AI label?
Is every output file in its aspect?
Are the 9:16 masters at -14 LUFS with a true peak at or below -1 dBTP?
Does report.md give the gate score of every layer and each version's final score against the screenplay?
Does report.md list the remaining flaws honestly, shot by shot?
Does report.md list every claim with its source from research.md?
questions.evidence: Quote one claim with its source.

questions.text: Does report.md state the spend from the ledger against the cap?
Does report.md tell the user to switch on the platform's AI label at upload, and say nothing was published?
In the 9:16 masters, is all text inside the safe zone and readable on a phone?
questions.evidence: Name the second of any clipped or tiny text.

questions.text: Is the picture free of text, logos or emblems inside AI-made images?
questions.evidence: Name the second of any text inside an image.

questions.text: Is every claim shown or said found in research.md?
questions.evidence: Name any claim not in research.md.
